lines.cap: They fight on the news. Then they go home. Together.

lines.cap: Not on my watch, Doctor Gloom!
lines.say: Not on my watch, Doctor Gloom!

lines.cap: Eleven p.m. Same bus. Same flat.
lines.say: Eleven p.m. Same bus. Same flat.

lines.cap: Also, you ate my yoghurt. It had my name on it.
lines.say: Also, you ate my yoghurt. It had my name on it.

lines.cap: Relax, buddy. I'll save the city. Right after you do the dishes.
lines.say: Relax, buddy. I'll save the city. Right after you do the dishes.
lines.bubble: I SAVE THE CITY. YOU DO DISHES. 🍽️

lines.cap: One day I will destroy him. After rent day.
lines.say: One day I will destroy him. After rent day.
lines.bubble: ONE DAY I'LL DESTROY HIM. AFTER RENT DAY. 💸

lines.cap: Rent day. The heater is broken. The landlord won't answer.
lines.say: Rent day. The heater is broken. The landlord won't answer.

lines.cap: Fine. Time for my evil plan.
lines.say: Fine. Time for my evil plan.

lines.cap: His evil plan? A very polite email.
lines.say: His evil plan? A very polite email.

lines.cap: Dear landlord. Fix the heater. Or else.
lines.say: Dear landlord. Fix the heater. Or else.

lines.cap: The next morning, the heater works.
lines.say: The next morning, the heater works.
